headline: French bank confirms cyberattack behind $133M crypto theft claim

scenes.vo: A major French bank just confirmed a cyberattack, days after an investigator traced over one hundred million dollars in stolen crypto. Here's what changed.
Investigator ZachXBT named Credit Mutuel Arkea as the victim. The bank says an attack enabled fraudulent transactions, but it has not confirmed an amount.
Here's why traders are watching it. The bank says clients face no financial losses, the incident is under control, and Crypto dot com says it blocked linked funds.
The catch. ZachXBT estimates over one hundred thirty three million dollars, and says slow disclosure let about thirty million slip away unfrozen.
Here's what happens next. Watch for the bank's official loss figure, more exchange freezes, and how European regulators respond.
